routes.serialization: ratingsBlock prints stars plus nonempty note
routes.schema: rating.note is required string with no length enum
routes.constraint: Only six rating-axis reasons fit semantically. Existing value is editable text; any tap-fill behavior must preserve user edits and avoid repeated insertion.

routes.serialization: flowBlock prints checks under phase label
routes.schema: phase.checks is required array of strings; no enum or maxItems
routes.constraint: Only events tied to that phase fit. renderForm renders only FLOW_PHASES choices; stored strings absent from current choice list are invisible during edit and dropped by collectRecord. Renamed labels have the same risk.

routes.serialization: No automatic article visibility; serializeRecord must explicitly include any field
routes.schema: New required properties would reject older records without normalization/migration; optional properties can preserve old imports
routes.constraint: Schema permits extra properties, but renderForm/collectRecord rebuild fixed fields and omit unknown fields on edit; validation, import/export, backup, fixtures and prompt paths need coordinated review.

existing_fees.form: courseFee choices 10000–30000円 in 1000円 steps with legacy-value option; optionFee/nominationFee numeric inputs
existing_fees.validation: feeValue accepts empty as null and only nonnegative safe integers; schema fee same
existing_fees.article: serializeRecord includes optionSystem and optionChosen, but omits courseFee, optionFee, nominationFee and bookingMethod
existing_fees.missing: No explicit paid-total, discount amount, or price-clarity field

focused_verification_if_implemented: For ratings.note reuse: selected phrase plus manual edits survives collectRecord, save/load, edit, import/export, and appears once with its star in serializeRecord.

For flow.checks reuse: only phase-correct choices are serialized under their phase; legacy and unknown stored strings survive an edit or are explicitly handled; no global observation is silently cast as a phase event.
For new fields: old v1 JSON imports and re-saves safely; new values survive save/load/export/import/backup restore; schema rejects malformed values and serializeRecord includes only intended facts.
Fee changes: null versus 0 and legacy courseFee values retain existing behavior; numeric values appear in article output only if deliberately serialized.
review_phase: pre-integration feasibility snapshot; current result in integration-validation.json
